title: search
description: Locate relevant sections in a long document by asking an auxiliary LLM to navigate the PageIndex tree. Returns a list of suggested page numbers (derived from matched tree nodes) plus a short rationale. Use as a coarse filter BEFORE Read whenever you don't already know which pages carry the evidence you need.

query.description: A detailed natural-language query describing what to find. Short keyword phrases are NOT enough — this is LLM-driven tree search, not keyword matching. Write a complete sentence or question that names the specific entity/topic, the aspect you need (definition, value, comparison, trend...), and any constraints (time period, demographic group, unit). Good: 'Find sections discussing the median household income for Latino families and how it compares to other racial groups.' Bad: 'income Latino'.

doc_id.description: (Multi-doc only) Restrict the search to the named document. Use one of the doc_ids listed in the user message. Omit to search across all documents in a merged series tree.
